question: Which of these is one of the seven priorities adopted in the Union Budget for the fiscal year 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Inclusive development**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inclusive development **is a priority that focuses on ensuring that **economic growth** benefits all segments of **society, including marginalized and vulnerable groups.**
 
• Inclusive development aims to **reduce inequalities **and **promote social justice** by providing access to education, healthcare, and other basic services to all citizens.
 
• Inclusive development also seeks to create **employment opportunities **and promote **entrepreneurship,** particularly in rural areas and among women and youth.
 
• The adoption of inclusive development as one of the** seven priorities in the Union Budget** for the fiscal year** 2023-24** demonstrates the government's commitment to building an** equitable and sustainable economy** that benefits all citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In order to steer the nation toward **"Amrit Kaal,**" the **Union Budget for FY 2023–2024** adopts the seven priorities known as **Saptarishi.**
 
• This serves as a model for an** empowered and inclusive** economy.
 
• The budget "Saptarishi" has** seven **key areas of focus:
 
 
• youth power, green growth, inclusive development, infrastructure, and investment, reaching the last mile, and the financial sector.
